name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 4 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2026-02-09, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
